narr: A stalled frontal boundary across south central Kansas coupled with ample upslope low level moisture aided in producing several inches of rain.
ev: Highway 42 was closed with 2 feet of water across the highway. Rain gauge reports of rainfall ranged from 5 to 6 inches.
lsr: HIGHWAY K2 WEST OF KIOWA CLOSED WITH 2 FT OF WATER OVER THE ROAD. RAIN GAUGE REPORTS IN THE AREA OF 5 TO 6 INCHES OF RAIN.
